title: Tisarana Accounts
kicker: Tisarana Buddhist Monastery · near Perth, Ontario, Canada
cpiName: the Canadian consumer price index (World Bank, yearly average)
costDefShort: total expenses in the monastery's statements, without amortization (wear on buildings and equipment, which is not money paid out).
defs: Running costs: the total expenses in the monastery's own yearly financial statements, without amortization (wear on buildings and equipment, not money paid out). Residents: the monks, novices, nuns and anagārikas listed at Tisarana on the community lists, on average; guests and lay residents are not counted. Inflation: the Canadian consumer price index (World Bank). All amounts in Canadian dollars, as paid at the time, unless the page says "in today's money".
incomeNote: Large gifts, many from abroad, make up much of the income from 2022; the monastery holds part of it as restricted money for the new meditation hall.
meaningNote: The statements change layout in 2022, so part of the rise may come from how costs are counted (see the notes); they give totals and a list of costs that changes from year to year, so this page shows the totals only.

holdSeries.name: Of which given for a set purpose

holdLede: The yearly statements also show cash, money given for a set purpose, and everything owned less everything owed.
holdSub: At 31 December. Cash includes the savings account that holds money given for a set purpose (restricted); net assets are everything owned less everything owed.
holdNote: Net assets are mostly land and buildings: property, plant and equipment was $6.1 million of the $6.5 million of assets at the end of 2025. Restricted money is the deferred income for the new meditation hall.
notes: Where the figures come from. The financial statements the monastery publishes on its own website (accounts/ in this folder): 2016 to 2025, prepared by its treasurer without audit ("notice to reader").
Years. The monastery's year is the calendar year, January to December.
Years read from the next report. The reports for 2020, 2022 and 2024 are scanned images, so those years are taken from the "last year" column of the next year's report, which may have been restated.

Changes of layout. The statements change layout in 2022 and again in 2024, and the report for 2023 restates earlier net assets (a prior-period adjustment of $667,207 against the 2022 opening figure). Years before and after 2021 are therefore not strictly like for like.

Running costs. Total expenses less amortization. Expenses also contain gifts the monastery passed on and, in some years, donations in kind (which also appear in income) and sales tax that could not be recovered ($86,200 in 2024 and $24,573 in 2025).
Money in. Total revenue (donations, donations in kind, interest and other income). For 2022 and 2023 interest and other income ($17,150 and $32,235) are added to the revenue line.
Not in the accounts. The work of volunteers is not valued in the statements.
Residents are the monks, novices, nuns and anagārikas on the community lists (the Winter list in January and the Vassa list in July). Guests, retreatants and lay residents are not counted.
sources: Sources anyone can check: the monastery's financial statements on tisarana.ca (2016 to 2025). Residents: the monasteries' community lists. Updated __UPDATED__
